## Implemented Boundary

The built-in-only parent binds the exact candidate Git blobs for the parent, harness, and verifier; materializes the complete candidate tree outside repository ancestry; rejects unsafe paths and aliases; validates registry and SRI lock supply; performs offline `npm ci` with lifecycle scripts disabled; builds through candidate-private TypeScript; binds source, dependency, toolchain, environment, and generated closures into one deterministic runtime digest; launches one fresh candidate child per phase; verifies protected closures before and after execution; validates mode-specific outputs; stages bytes privately; performs bounded cleanup; promotes immutable bytes atomically per file; and records a parent execution receipt.

The harness has built-in-only static imports and validates the parent context, invocation token, candidate tooling, toolchain, environment, source, dependency, and generated closures before dynamically importing candidate-private `dist/index.js`.

The verifier has built-in-only static imports. It validates the parent context and candidate tooling before dynamically importing the authenticated candidate-private harness, which completes runtime validation before exposing specialist verification functions.

The direct `runtimeBindingDigest` is propagated and compared through the runtime-binding context, candidate manifest, phase metadata, compilation summary, approval, child output, and final handoff-verification report.

`package.json` exposes `release-review:v12` and includes the parent, harness, and verifier in format and lint commands. The two approved test files add bounded adversarial coverage for direct worker invocation, import boundaries, runtime-digest substitution, unsafe paths, lock substitution, hardlinks, escaping links, closure mutation, output boundaries, closed environments, cleanup ordering, and immutable promotion.

## Timeout Diagnosis

The previous specialist-host run was terminated by its arbitrary 300-second cap and produced no completed result. Integration independently established that no `.local/v12-release-gate` scratch remained, the review file passed 11/11 in 70.4 seconds, every gate case passed independently, the three heavy legacy gate cases took 126.9, 125.9, and 73.8 seconds, and the complete gate file passed 13/13 in 325.8 seconds.

Attempt 3 directly confirmed the diagnosis: the exact combined command completed successfully in 336.2 seconds, below its eight-minute process cap. The earlier timeout was cumulative serial materialization cost, not a retained process or product defect.

## Deliberately Deferred

No candidate R2 phase or full repository gate was run. Fresh candidate R2 execution, full offline release verification, hosted CI, release readiness, and merge remain integration-owner responsibilities.

## Residual Host Boundary

The implementation does not claim protection from hostile same-user processes, compromised executables or operating systems, untrusted cache provisioning, or an IDE that bypasses the parent entrypoint. Those controls remain external-host responsibilities.
